summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of MaterialMatch AI - all 26 backend tests passing including full AI analysis pipeline with Claude Sonnet 4.5 vision. Frontend smoke tests passing for landing, auth gating, registration, dashboard, and project creation flow.
action_items: Optional: Add data-testid attributes to key interactive elements (register name/email/password inputs, submit buttons, new-project button, project name input, file dropzones, Start AI analysis button) for more robust automated testing. Current tests succeeded using fallback selectors but data-testid would be more reliable.
Optional: ADMIN_PASSWORD default fallback in server.py is 'admin123' which is weak. Recommend removing the default to fail fast if env missing (already pattern used for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME).
Optional: CORS list has 'http://localhost:3000' hardcoded alongside FRONTEND_URL env var - consider env-only configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 668 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, projects.py, analysis.py, models.py) for maintainability as the app grows.
run_analysis() background task sends each catalogue item to Claude sequentially - could be parallelized with asyncio.gather() for faster analysis with large catalogues.
JWT_SECRET is committed to /app/backend/.env - acceptable for preview but should be rotated/secret-managed in production.
No file size limit on PDFs in /catalogue endpoint (only images have 5MB cap and the entire upload has no aggregate size limit beyond FastAPI defaults).
_parse_json fallback uses text[start:end+1] which can break on nested objects when LLM returns multiple top-level JSON-like fragments - works for current prompts but is fragile.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@materialmatch.ai / MaterialAdmin2026! (verified working). Ephemeral test users created per-test-run with unique emails (e.g. test_user_<uuid>@test.com / TestPass2026!).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: one TEST_Project_E2E project with reference image + 2 catalogue images and one completed analysis report. Multiple TEST_ prefixed users created (test_user_*, other_*, empty_*, uitest_*). Cleanup via DELETE /api/projects/{id} executed in test_cleanup_delete_project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional - all 26 pytest tests pass in ~25s including full Claude Sonnet 4.5 vision analysis E2E (reference analysis + 2 catalogue matches). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. To re-run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest backend_test.py -v. Frontend pages have minimal data-testid coverage but use semantic selectors (input[type=email], input[type=password], button[type=submit]) work reliably. Full UI E2E (upload + analyze + report download) was not executed via Playwright due to ~1-2min Claude inference time per project, but the backend test test_poll_status_until_complete validates the entire analysis pipeline.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Backend bcrypt format ($2b$), httpOnly cookies, CORS with explicit origins + allow_credentials, JWT cookie+Bearer fallback, admin seed idempotency - all verified per auth_testing playbook.
